NSSymbolAppearEffect.doc: A type that makes the layers of a symbol-based image appear separately or as a whole.

NSSymbolAutomaticContentTransition.doc: A type that applies the default animation to a symbol-based image in a context-sensitive manner.

NSSymbolBounceEffect.doc: A type that applies a transitory scaling effect, or bounce, to the layers in a symbol-based image separately or as a whole.

NSSymbolBreatheEffect.doc: A symbol effect that applies the Breathe animation to symbol images.

NSSymbolContentTransition.doc: An abstract base class for transitions you can apply to symbol-based images.

NSSymbolDisappearEffect.doc: A type that makes the layers of a symbol-based image disappear separately or as a whole.

NSSymbolDrawOffEffect.doc: A symbol effect that applies the DrawOff animation to symbol images.

NSSymbolDrawOnEffect.doc: A symbol effect that applies the DrawOn animation to symbol images.

NSSymbolEffect.doc: An abstract base class for effects that you can apply to a symbol-based image.

NSSymbolEffectOptions.doc: Options that configure how effects apply to symbol-based images.

NSSymbolEffectOptionsRepeatBehavior.doc: The behavior of repetition to use when a symbol effect is animating.

NSSymbolMagicReplaceContentTransition.doc: A symbol effect applies the MagicReplace animation to symbol images.

NSSymbolPulseEffect.doc: A type that fades the opacity of some or all layers in a symbol-based image.

NSSymbolReplaceContentTransition.doc: A type that replaces the layers of one symbol-based image with those of another.

NSSymbolRotateEffect.doc: A symbol effect that applies the Rotate animation to symbol images.

NSSymbolScaleEffect.doc: A type that scales the layers in a symbol-based image separately or as a whole.

NSSymbolVariableColorEffect.doc: A type that replaces the opacity of variable layers in a symbol-based image in a repeatable sequence.

NSSymbolWiggleEffect.doc: A symbol effect that applies the Wiggle animation to symbol images.

+appearDownEffect.doc: An effect that makes the symbol scale down as it appears.

+appearUpEffect.doc: An effect that makes the symbol scale up as it appears.

+effect.doc: An animation that makes the layers of a symbol-based image appear separately or as a whole.

-effectWithByLayer.doc: An effect that makes each layer appear separately.

-effectWithWholeSymbol.doc: An effect that makes all layers appear simultaneously.

+transition.doc: A transition that applies the default animation to a symbol-based image in a context-sensitive manner.

+bounceDownEffect.doc: An effect that bounces the symbol downward.

+bounceUpEffect.doc: An effect that bounces the symbol upward.

+effect.doc: An animation that applies a transitory scaling effect, or bounce, to the layers in a symbol-based image separately or as a whole.

-effectWithByLayer.doc: An effect that bounces each layer separately.

-effectWithWholeSymbol.doc: An effect that bounces all layers simultaneously.

+breathePlainEffect.doc: Convenience initializer for a breathe effect that makes the symbol breathe with no other styling.

+breathePulseEffect.doc: Convenience initializer for a breathe effect that pulses layers as they breathe.

+effect.doc: The default breathe effect, determined by the system.

-effectWithByLayer.doc: Returns a copy of the effect that animates incrementally, by layer.

-effectWithWholeSymbol.doc: Returns a copy of the effect that animates all layers of the symbol simultaneously.

+disappearDownEffect.doc: An effect that scales the symbol down as it disappears.

+disappearUpEffect.doc: An effect that scales the symbol up as it disappears.

+effect.doc: An animation that makes the layers of a symbol-based image disappear separately or as a whole.

-effectWithByLayer.doc: An effect that makes each layer disappear separately.

-effectWithWholeSymbol.doc: An effect that makes all layers disappear simultaneously.

+effect.doc: The default draw off effect, determined by the system.

-effectWithByLayer.doc: Returns a copy of the effect requesting an animation that applies separately to each motion group.

-effectWithIndividually.doc: Returns a copy of the effect requesting an animation that applies separately to each motion group, where only one motion group is active at a time.

-effectWithNonReversed.doc: Returns a copy of the effect that only animates forwards. This cancels the reversed variant.

-effectWithReversed.doc: Returns a copy of the effect that animates in reverse. This cancels the nonReversed variant.

-effectWithWholeSymbol.doc: Returns a copy of the effect requesting an animation that applies to all motion groups simultaneously.

+effect.doc: The default draw on effect, determined by the system.

-effectWithByLayer.doc: Returns a copy of the effect requesting an animation that applies separately to each motion group.

-effectWithIndividually.doc: Returns a copy of the effect requesting an animation that applies separately to each motion group, where only one motion group is active at a time.

-effectWithWholeSymbol.doc: Returns a copy of the effect requesting an animation that applies to all motion groups simultaneously.

+options.doc: The default set of effect options.

+optionsWithNonRepeating.doc: A default set of effect options that prefers to not repeat.

+optionsWithRepeatBehavior:.doc: Convenience initializer setting a preferred repeat behavior.

+optionsWithRepeatCount:.doc: A default set of effect options with a preferred repeat count.

+optionsWithRepeating.doc: A default set of effect options that prefers to repeat indefinitely.

+optionsWithSpeed:.doc: A default set of effect options with a preferred speed multiplier.

-optionsWithNonRepeating.doc: A set of effect options that prefers to not repeat.

-optionsWithRepeatBehavior:.doc: Return a copy of the options setting a preferred repeat behavior.

-optionsWithRepeatCount:.doc: Creates a set of effect options with a preferred repeat count.

-optionsWithRepeating.doc: A set of effect options that prefers to repeat indefinitely.

-optionsWithSpeed:.doc: Creates a set of effect options with a preferred speed multiplier.

+behaviorContinuous.doc: Creates and returns a repeat behavior that prefers to repeat indefinitely, using continuous animations if available. Continuous animations have an intro, a body that runs as long as the effect is enabled, and an outro. If available these animations provide a smoother animation when an effect repeats indefinitely.

+behaviorPeriodic.doc: Creates and returns a repeat behavior that prefers to repeat indefinitely using periodic animations. Periodic animations play the effect at regular intervals starting and stopping each time.

+behaviorPeriodicWithCount:.doc: Creates and returns a repeat behavior with a preferred play count using periodic animations. Periodic animations play the effect at regular intervals starting and stopping each time.

+behaviorPeriodicWithCount:delay:.doc: Creates and returns a repeat behavior with a preferred play count and delay using periodic animations. Periodic animations play the effect at regular intervals starting and stopping each time.

+behaviorPeriodicWithDelay:.doc: Creates and returns a repeat behavior with a preferred repeat delay using periodic animations. Periodic animations play the effect at regular intervals starting and stopping each time.

+effect.doc: The default pulse effect, determined by the system.

-effectWithByLayer.doc: A copy of the effect requesting an animation that pulses only the layers marked to always pulse.

-effectWithWholeSymbol.doc: A copy of the effect requesting an animation that pulses all layers simultaneously.

+magicTransitionWithFallback:.doc: Convenience initializer for a MagicReplace content transition with a configured Replace fallback.

+replaceDownUpTransition.doc: An effect that replaces a symbol by scaling it down, and scaling a different symbol up.

+replaceOffUpTransition.doc: An effect that replaces a symbol by removing it, and scaling a different symbol up.

+replaceUpUpTransition.doc: An effect that replaces a symbol by scaling it up, and scaling a different symbol up.

+transition.doc: An effect that replaces the layers of one symbol-based image with those of another.

-transitionWithByLayer.doc: An effect that replaces each layer separately.

-transitionWithWholeSymbol.doc: An effect that replaces all layers simultaneously.

+effect.doc: The default rotate effect, determined by the system.

+rotateClockwiseEffect.doc: Convenience initializer for a rotate effect that rotates clockwise.

+rotateCounterClockwiseEffect.doc: Convenience initializer for a rotate effect that rotates counter-clockwise.

-effectWithByLayer.doc: Returns a copy of the effect that animates incrementally, by layer.

+effect.doc: An animation that replaces the opacity of variable layers in a symbol-based image in a repeatable sequence.

-effectWithCumulative.doc: An effect that enables each layer of a symbol-based image in sequence.

-effectWithDimInactiveLayers.doc: An effect that dims inactive layers in a symbol-based image.

-effectWithHideInactiveLayers.doc: An effect that hides inactive layers in a symbol-based image.

-effectWithIterative.doc: An effect that momentarily enables each layer of a symbol-based image in sequence.

-effectWithNonReversing.doc: An effect that doesn’t reverse each time it repeats.

-effectWithReversing.doc: An effect that reverses each time it repeats.

+effect.doc: The default wiggle effect, determined by the system.

+wiggleBackwardEffect.doc: Convenience initializer for a wiggle effect that moves back and forth horizontally based on the current locale, starting by moving backward.

+wiggleClockwiseEffect.doc: Convenience initializer for a wiggle effect that rotates back and forth, starting by rotating clockwise.

+wiggleCounterClockwiseEffect.doc: Convenience initializer for a wiggle effect that rotates back and forth, starting by rotating counter-clockwise.

+wiggleCustomAngleEffect:.doc: Convenience initializer for a wiggle effect that moves back and forth along an axis, starting by moving toward a custom angle.

+wiggleDownEffect.doc: Convenience initializer for a wiggle effect that moves back and forth vertically, starting by moving down.

+wiggleForwardEffect.doc: Convenience initializer for a wiggle effect that moves back and forth horizontally based on the current locale, starting by moving forward.

+wiggleLeftEffect.doc: Convenience initializer for a wiggle effect that moves back and forth horizontally, starting by moving left.

+wiggleRightEffect.doc: Convenience initializer for a wiggle effect that moves back and forth horizontally, starting by moving right.

+wiggleUpEffect.doc: Convenience initializer for a wiggle effect that moves back and forth vertically, starting by moving up.
